title: Gunman's Walk
description: A rugged rancher (Van Heflin) with good and bad sons can only stop his bad son (Tab Hunter) with a gun.

title: Indian Uprising
description: Gold thieves and the government rile Geronimo, despite a cavalry captain's (George Montgomery) efforts at peace.

title: Cowboy
description: A Chicago hotel desk clerk (Jack Lemmon) talks a trail boss (Glenn Ford) into taking him on a cattle drive to Mexico.

title: The Taming of the West
description: A new lawman (Bill Elliott) punches out cattle rustlers who like to shoot sheriffs.

title: The Last Frontier
description: Three trappers become scouts for a cavalry captain (Guy Madison) who loses his fort to a hated colonel (Robert Preston).

title: 7th Cavalry
description: Absent from Custer's Last Stand, an Army captain (Randolph Scott) volunteers for the Little Bighorn burial detail.

title: Adventures in Silverado
description: A stagecoach driver seeks to capture "The Monk," a notorious highwayman, in order to clear himself.

title: Unknown Valley
description: Joe goes looking for his missing father in the desert, then strange villagers take him captive; he finds his father and plans to escape, taking with him a woman that he has fallen for.

title: Go West, Young Girl!
description: New England writer Netty and cavalry widow Gilda team up to find Billy the Kid.

title: Reprisal!
description: An Indian girl (Kathryn Grant) and a land agent's daughter (Felicia Farr) save a part-Indian cattle rancher (Guy Madison) from vigilantes.

title: Forbidden Trail
description: A practical-joking cowboy (Buck Jones) gets serious with outlaws.

title: The Professionals
description: A circa-1917 rancher sends mercenaries (Lee Marvin, Burt Lancaster) to rescue his kidnapped wife (Claudia Cardinale) from a Mexican bandit.

title: Ten Wanted Men
description: An Arizona rancher (Randolph Scott) protects his empire from a rival landowner (Richard Boone) and his hired guns.

title: Good Day for a Hanging
description: The new marshal (Fred MacMurray) is the only one in town who thinks a charming killer (Robert Vaughn) should hang.

title: Phantom Stagecoach
description: A dispute between stage lines ends with a steel-armored stagecoach.

title: Last of the Comanches
description: A cavalry sergeant (Broderick Crawford) leads soldiers, civilians and an Indian (Johnny Stewart) on a desert trek.

title: The Texas Rangers
description: The fastest gun (George Montgomery) in Texas is let out of prison to help the Rangers stop a gang of outlaws.

title: The Gun That Won the West
description: Superior Springfield rifles help scouts (Dennis Morgan, Richard Denning) and the cavalry get forts built in Wyoming.

title: King of the Wild Horses
description: A mustang stallion runs swiftly to the rescue when the boy who befriended him is endangered.

title: Relentless
description: Framed for a murder he didn't commit, a cowboy hides with a traveling woman as he flees a sheriff and hunts for the real killer.

title: Ambush at Tomahawk Gap
description: Flaming arrows stop four ex-convicts searching a ghost town for their buried loot.

title: The Hard Man
description: A Texas Ranger (Guy Madison) turns deputy sheriff; a woman (Valerie French) wants him to kill her cattle-baron husband (Lorne Greene).

title: Al Jennings of Oklahoma
description: Lawyer Al (Dan Duryea) and brother Frank (Dick Foran) turn to robbing banks and trains after Union troops raid their home.

title: Legend of the Golden Gun
description: An Old West gunfighter (Hal Holbrook) turns a young farmer (Jeff Osterhage) into a justice fighter with a special gun.

title: The New Daughters of Joshua Cabe
description: A framed sheriff (John McIntire) is about to hang, but his bogus wayward daughters have a plan.

title: The Pathfinder
description: A British scout (Kevin Dillon) infiltrates a French stronghold near the Great Lakes during the 1750s.

title: Face of a Fugitive
description: A bank robber (Fred MacMurray) takes a new name in another town and falls for the lawyer-sheriff's (Lin McCarthy) sister (Dorothy Green).

title: The Longest Drive
description: Two brothers (Kurt Russell, Tim Matheson), one raised by Indians, seek their sister in the 1890s West.

title: Apache Territory
description: A drifter crossing the Arizona desert routs a band of marauding Apaches and rescues the young survivor of a massacre.

title: Riding Wild
description: A ranch foreman tries to thwart a crook's attempts to run his employers off their land.

title: They Rode West
description: The new doctor (Robert Francis) at a cavalry fort finds resentment at first, even more once he treats Indians.

title: The Violent Men
description: A rancher (Glenn Ford) fights a land-grabbing cattle baron (Edward G. Robinson) whose wife (Barbara Stanwyck) and brother are having an affair.

title: Battle of Rogue River
description: A cavalry major (George Montgomery) makes peace with Indians despite an agitator (Richard Denning) working for carpetbaggers.

title: Santa Fe
description: Three brothers become outlaws after the Civil War, while a fourth sibling goes to work for the railroad.

title: The Wild Westerners
description: A U.S. marshal (James Philbrook) and his wife (Nancy Kovack) bring Union gold east through outlaws and Indians.

title: Major Dundee
description: A Union major (Charlton Heston) chases Indians to Mexico with a condemned Confederate captain (Richard Harris) and a cavalry of prisoners.

title: Western Code
description: Tim Barrett, a renowned lawman, rescues Patty from a ruffian and saves her brother from being lynched.

title: Gun Fury
description: A peaceful man (Rock Hudson) hunts down the outlaw (Phil Carey) who has abducted his bride (Donna Reed).

title: Fighting Fool
